summary: End-to-end verified the new manual payouts / card-pay feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_payouts.py — GET/PUT /api/payouts/bank enforce admin_only (consultant & client → 403), Pydantic validation rejects wrong account_number length (6/8 digits), non-katakana holder, bad account_type and 3-digit bank_code; PUT with empty bank_code/branch_code (optional fields) works; stored value is encrypted (tenants.payout_bank.enc, plaintext account number absent from Mongo doc) and audit_logs.payout_bank entry contains '***4567' and NOT '1234567'. Card gating: GET /api/invoices returns card_enabled=true for FINORA Wealth Partners (bank set) and card_enabled=false for tenant B; POST /api/stripe/checkout/invoice returns 409 with the JP message when the tenant's payout_bank is unset, and after re-set the call succeeds (either 200 with checkout_url or 400 'Stripe: ...' from live account rejection — both mean gating passed). Payout ledger: seeded 2 STRIPE payments in tenant A (one with stripe_fee=3600 explicit, one without → estimated at round(50000*0.036)=1800, fee_estimated=true); GET /api/platform/payouts is 403 for consultant and returns tenant A row with both items and correct pending (96400 + 48200); POST /api/platform/payouts/{tenant_b} → 409 (no bank); POST for tenant A with transfer_fee=330 creates db.payouts doc (bank masked ***4567, status SENT, amount=total−330), sets payments.payout_settled=net so pending is filtered out on next GET, and tenant admin GET /api/payouts includes the new payout id in history; a subsequent refunded_amount=20000 update on the settled payment reintroduces the row with pending=-20000 (negative pending → next payout deducts). Regression: payouts.record_fee(pid, None, 25000) — with Stripe unreachable — stores stripe_fee=900 and stripe_fee_estimated=true, confirming _fulfill's post-fulfillment fee recording works even under the estimate fallback. Frontend (headless Chromium, JA): admin ryuichi.kurozaki@gmail.com → /settings → 請求者情報 tab shows payout-bank-card with badge '登録済み', bank_name '三菱UFJ銀行', account_number '1234567', holder 'カ）フィノラ', account_type ORDINARY, and payout-status-card with payout-pending-total '¥0' and empty history (after cleanup); /platform → platform-tab-payouts renders payout-table and payout-history-table (0 rows because we removed all STRIPE payments in cleanup — expected); client@finora.co.jp sees exactly 1 invoice-card-pay-{id} button on INV-202609-0002 (payable) since tenant A bank is set; consultantb@finora.co.jp Settings badge = '未登録' with empty pb-account_number; clientb@finora.co.jp /billing has 0 card-pay buttons (gated by card_enabled=false). Cleanup done: TEST_PAYOUT_* payments and payouts deleted, payout_sent notifications removed. FINORA Wealth Partners keeps its registered bank as noted allowed in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: payouts.BankIn.holder_kana pattern accepts ASCII uppercase A-Z and full-width Ａ-Ｚ + digits + several punctuation, matching real Japanese bank katakana holder names (e.g. 'カ）フィノラ'). Correct — 'abc' (lowercase) is rejected because the regex requires uppercase.

payouts.mark_sent iterates p['items'] and sets payments.payout_settled=net (not increments). If a payment is settled twice via two payouts (edge case if pending re-appears via refund reversal to positive), the second run overwrites payout_settled — currently OK because pending is derived from net − payout_settled and net drops after refund; but a future refund-reversal path should switch to $inc to be safe.
payouts.pending filters items with abs(pending)>=0.5. Good: keeps negative-pending rows (after-payout refunds) visible so the next payout deducts. Correct.
stripe_payments.checkout_invoice gating checks tenant.payout_bank presence via a projection — fast and correct. Message string is bilingual JP/EN which is fine for a 409.

payouts.record_fee uses asyncio.to_thread with stripe_fee_sync — good for not blocking the loop. On Stripe error it falls back to estimated fee AND flags stripe_fee_estimated=true so the ledger surfaces the '*' asterisk correctly in the UI.

PayoutsPanel disables payout-send-{tid} when !r.bank || r.total<=0 — matches spec. The dialog also disables submit under the same condition, but transfer_fee > total is only guarded server-side (409). Consider a client-side hint when total-transfer_fee<=0 (minor UX).
PayoutSettings.BankForm auto-trims empty strings via inline onChange. Because Pydantic BankIn.bank_code uses pattern '^(\d{4})?$', empty is accepted — matches JP-optional codes.
core.audit stores in db.audit_logs with entity field (not 'resource'). Fixed the test accordingly — no code change needed.
payouts.masked returns None when bank is None (short-circuit in `b and {...}`). Guards platform history docs where bank was set at payout time (always non-None in mark_sent path).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: admin settings, platform payouts tab, client A card-pay visible, tenant B 未登録, client B no card-pay)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded 2 db.payments docs (id starts with TEST_PAYOUT_<uuid>) in tenant A during test class, then a db.payouts doc via POST /api/platform/payouts/{tenant_a} with note=TEST_PAYOUT_*. Fixture teardown deletes all TEST_PAYOUT_* payments, payouts, and payout_sent notifications. Post-run DB state verified clean: 0 TEST_PAYOUT payments, 0 TEST_PAYOUT payouts, 0 payout_sent notifications. FINORA Wealth Partners tenants.payout_bank left in place (registered) as explicitly allowed in the request; tenant B unchanged (no bank).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_payouts.py is xdist-parallel-safe and uses --asyncio-mode=auto (pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 installed). It seeds a class-scoped fixture that creates/deletes TEST_PAYOUT_* rows. If you need to re-run, ensure FINORA Wealth Partners tenant retains a payout_bank OR remove the two tests that assume it (test_invoices_card_enabled_true_after_bank, test_checkout_succeeds_or_stripe_error_once_bank_set). Live Stripe key may reject checkout with 400 'Stripe: ...' — the test accepts both 200 and 400 as PASS since both mean tenant-side gating succeeded (409-gate absent). The frontend Settings 'payout-bank-card' lives inside the 請求者情報 tab, click it before probing the data-testids.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 6 features listed in the request are functioning as specified: bank RBAC + validation + encryption + audit masking, settings UI cards, card-pay gating (list + checkout 409), platform payout ledger (with fee estimation + refund-carryover), platform payouts tab & dialog, and _fulfill's post-payment record_fee regression.
